 Enter iHerb's Unwrap K-Glow Beauty Bag . For less than $35 , you can gift (to yourself or someone else) nine products across top-rated brands. It includes:

 So, if you're in the market for some new skincare to try out (or gift away), keep scrolling to shop this iHerb-exclusive set on sale for a limited time.
 For a limited time, get iHerb's Unwrap K-Glow Beauty Bag for $34.43 (30% off their $49 retail price). 
 This exclusive Korean beauty set has nine full- and travel-sized products —from milky toners and pads to retinol serums and eye creams—in a cute clear bag.
 With a near-perfect rating of 4.8 stars , reviewers love the variety of products, saying it leaves their skin hydrated, soothed, and radiant.

 "I love the variety of products in this beauty bag ! It's a fantastic way to explore Korean skincare and discover new favorites without purchasing full-size products. The selection is thoughtfully curated, and the products are perfect for adding some extra glow and hydration to your skincare routine. The set is also beautifully packaged and makes a wonderful gift. Great value for the price! Highly recommend!"
 "Products inside are great; when on offer, I’d highly recommend . Not sure I’d buy it at full price unless you’re specifically wanting these items. High quality, though."

I loved its contents; I've been trying out the products, and it's an excellent indicator of whether I want to add them to my routine later. I highly recommend it."
